messages.name: Researcher
messages.content: Read the first 16 lines of docs/MODEL.md with read_project_record. Then return the exact title and citation from the tool.

function.name: read_project_record
function.description: Read real project documentation or acceptance JSON under docs/, or the installed release metadata build/q4t.release.json. Returns numbered lines, a source SHA256 and an exact citation. Use the returned citation verbatim in the answer.
